for ($i = 0; $i -lt $content.Length; $i++) {
    if ($content[$i] -like '*id="coloringSvg"*') {
        $startIndex = $i
        break
    }
}

# Find end index

    if ($content[$i] -like '*Gradient Color Grid (36 Colors in 3 Rows of 12)*' -or $content[$i] -like '*Gradient Color Grid*') {

        break
    }
}

                  <circle cx="137" cy="101" r="3" fill="#ffffff" />
                  <!-- Cheeks -->
                  <ellipse class="paintable" cx="72" cy="115" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1e1e24" stroke-width="2.5" style="cursor: pointer; transition: fill 0.3s;" />
                  <ellipse class="paintable" cx="158" cy="115" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1e1e24" stroke-width="2.5" style="cursor: pointer; transition: fill 0.3s;" />
                  <!-- Mouth -->
                  <path d="M 110 116 Q 115 121 120 116" stroke="#1e1e24" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />

                  <path class="paintable" d="M 30 160 C 15 160, 15 185, 35 185 C 35 185, 40 195, 60 195 C 75 195, 80 185, 90 190 C 105 195, 125 195, 135 185 C 145 195, 175 195, 175 175 C 190 175, 190 160, 170 160 Z" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1e1e24" stroke-width="4" style="cursor: pointer; transition: fill 0.3s;" />

"@
    
    # Keep lines from end index to end of file
    for ($i = $endIndex; $i -lt $content.Length; $i++) {
        $newContent += $content[$i]
    }
    
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($filePath, $newContent, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
    Write-Output "Successfully patched index.html"
} else {
    Write-Error "Could not find start or end tags!"
}
